Saikat Chakrabarti for Congress (@saikatc)

The AI lobby has entered our race to bankroll my opponent, Scott Wiener. That's because he worked with them to water down AI regulations in California. As his reward, he gets a huge super PAC.

I'm not taking any corporat

He’s got a lot more going for him, but at a minimum, you know he’s not going to sell out to Israel.

30 members of my family have died in Gaza, including children. 

I’d be the only member of congress who lived in Gaza. 

After 80 years, it’s time to end the bloodshed. Palestinian and Jewish children have the inherent right to exist and live with peace, safety and dignity.

Since the national media attacked @AbdulElSayed for appearing with @hasanthehun, he has gone up an astounding 15-20 points in the race! It totally backfired! I love living in a world where mainstream media is despised and whoever is tougher on Israel is more likely to win!

Good news is there is a deal to be had, if we want it. Iran has offered to take uranium out of their country for a number of years and we have discussed unfreezing some of their assets. Everyone wants this deal, except Israel. So, if we continue the war, it was definitely Israel.

He makes it seem like, in this completely disingenous speech, that Hillary Clinton and Kamala Harris were the only options. And that it was either them or Trump. Booker worked overtime to defeat our better candidates because they wouldn't serve Israel. He chose to lose to Trump!

Even Israeli organizations are now confirming the IDF are sick terrorists. Just reading about what they do to Palestinians is unbearable. This is how they have oppressed and humiliated them for last six decades, as American media pretended the Israeli terrorists were the victims.


Shaiel Ben-Ephraim (@academic_la)

Younger generation of right-wingers are now seeing @FoxNews lie right in front of their eyes and they’re waking up to the fact that they’ve been fed a lot of bullshit by that propaganda outfit. They always back war and subservience to Israel. Now a lot of right-wing sees it, too!

I criticized Obama a lot when he was president. He loved the establishment and it largely neutered his presidency. But the peace deal he made with Iran was one of the best things he did. We ended any theoretical nuclear threat from Iran and all we did was return their money.

Right-wing media has been lying about this for a long time. Fox News wanted to smear Obama and help Israel drive us into war.. Under Obama deal, we gave back money that was originally Iran’s and ended their nuclear weapons program. We lost nothing. That was a great peace deal!


Ro Khanna (@RoKhanna)

.@BarackObama did his homework. He engaged in statesmanship that left America safer & built a coalition to prevent Iran from having enriched uranium. 

All Trump did is listen to Netanyahu. Tha

If we go back into this war completely, both Trump and Israel have no idea how deeply they’ll be hated. 

No amount of mainstream media propaganda will save them from being thoroughly despised by the American people.

2/3 of Americans don't want this war. If our government worked for us, this would be a no-brainer. But our government works for a different country, so we're forced to die in their wars of choice. And pay billions a day for a war only Israel wants. We are not sovereign.

What has Trump done for the average American? Absolutely nothing. 

What has he done for Israel? Everything they asked for. Including a disastrous war we hate, but are forced to fight and pay for. 

Is he compromised? Obviously.

They have offered Iran absolutely nothing in return. We're not even ending our blockade of them in return. This is just a bullshit way of saying "we tried, but they left us no choice." It's a preemptive excuse for going deeper into the war. Israel is 100% driving this agenda.

Trump is making the maximum Israeli demands of Iran. That they have no enrichment at all, they open up the Strait of Hormuz and they hand over their foreign policy to Israel and promise never to fund any allies. They will never agree to that. This is a way of guaranteeing war.

You guys are a joke. If it’s such great investment for us to give you $320 billion, then as the great allies we are, well let you reap the rewards of the same exact investment - so, give us the $320 billion back! That way, you’ll be enriched, according to your logic.


AIPAC 🇺🇸🇮🇱 (@AIPAC)

No, @RoKhanna, you are Team Ro.

Team America upholds our commitments, stands with allies and helps allies stop terrorists from killing civilians.

Aid to Israel isn’t a handout. It’s a strategic investment th

At least there's one guy fighting for us. And by us, I mean both the overwhelming majority of Democrats who don't want this war and don't want to fund Israel's war machine, but I also mean all Americans. Because huge majorities of this country are against the war and Israel now.


Ro Khanna (@RoKhanna)

No taxpayer $$ to Israel. 

No Israeli PM in Situation Room.

End occupation.

I am Team America. Trump is obsessed with war in the Middle East.

It's time for a new generation for a new moral di

Congratulations to Israel who has succeeded in dragging us back into this war. They told Trump that he is so mighty and strong that he doesn't have to concede anything to Iranians, and he's so stupid he believed it. Now more of us will die and suffer for Israel. Sickening.
